title: Ad-hoc resilience checklist + contact lattice (Apr 2028)
body:
Sheet: Resilience checklist & contact lattice (ad-hoc)

-- CONTACT LATTICE (rows are lightweight, use this as quick reference during oncall) --
Columns: Service, Primary (name + role), Primary Pager, Secondary (name), Secondary Pager, Slack channel, Escalation order, RTO, RPO, Resilience score (0-5), Fallback endpoint, Runbook link, Notes

Search-indexing, Jonah Li (eng-search-lead), +1-555-0110, Priya Menon, +1-555-0111, #search-ops, Jonah -> Priya -> SRE, 5m, 1m, 4, search-fallback.redwood.internal:8080, https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=12345, Cache-heavy; prefix-caching enabled; see INF-2384 for recent throttle incident
Realtime-routing, Marco Alvarez (platform), +1-555-0220, Alex Foster, +1-555-0221, #platform-routing, Marco -> Alex -> SWAT, 2m, 30s, 5, routing-fallback.redwood:8000, https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=22333, KV cache warmers must run on deploy
Host-api (public), Priya Menon (api-owner), +1-555-0333, Rina Chatterjee, +1-555-0334, #api-public, Priya -> Rina -> Eng SRE, 120s, 60s, 3, api-readonly.redwood.com, https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=33121, Rate-limit automation sometimes misfires under burst; manual throttle step included below
Embedding-pipeline, Sarah Kim (mlinfra), +1-555-0440, Jonah Li, +1-555-0110, #embeddings, Sarah -> Jonah -> ML-SRE, 10m, 5m, 2, embeddings-cache:staging, https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=41211, Batch reprocessing job can be kicked as fallback
Dedicated-router, Theo Martins (dedicated), +1-555-0555, Marco Alvarez, +1-555-0220, #dedicated-ops, Theo -> Marco -> Infra, 30s, 15s, 4, dedicated-fallback.cluster, https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=55678, Autoscaler sticky sessions: manual override steps in runbook

-- QUICK SCORING RUBRIC (for oncall) --
0 = service down, no known fallback; requires exec pager + full incident bridge
1 = degraded, fallback available but high manual effort (>30m)
2 = degraded, fallback semi-automated (~10-30m)
3 = minor degradation, automated fallback with monitoring (~<10m)
4 = healthy with graceful fallback options
5 = fully resilient under expected load patterns

-- CHECKLIST (ad-hoc, run during pre-release window or when capacity changes) --
1) Verify primary & secondary pager numbers are correct (SMS test if safe)
2) Confirm runbook link loads and runbook steps are < 10 steps for critical flows
3) Ensure fallback endpoint DNS resolves from both us-east and eu-west
4) Run a simulated prefix-cache hit test (score must be >= 80%)
5) Confirm autoscaler policy has burst capacity >= 20% for next 24h
6) Quick cost impact estimate: if fallback is used, expected incremental token cost (low/med/high)

-- SAMPLE ENTRY: manual throttle (Host-api) --
Issue: sudden token storm from customer X causing 5xx surge
Immediate action: flip host-api to readonly (manual toggle) -> notify customers + enable degraded-mode header
Owner: Priya Menon; Backup: Rina Chatterjee
Manual steps: 1) /ops/feature-toggle -> set host-api.readonly = true 2) /ops/rate-limit -> apply emergency policy 3) verify replication -> monitor logs
Estimated time to recovery: 6-12 minutes (if manual steps succeed)
Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=33121
Linked ticket: INF-2384
Escalation: if not resolved in 15m -> page Marco (platform) and start incident bridge

-- IMMEDIATE NEXT ACTIONS (short list to hand off) --
- Jonah: SMS test for Search primary/secondary by 2028-04-13 (Jira INF-2410)
- Priya: tighten emergency rate-limit policy and add dry-run by 2028-04-18 (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-runbooks/pull/42)
- Marco: validate DNS resolution across regions and add synthetic check (due 2028-04-20)
- Rina: update contact lattice with vendor on-call POC for caching (open note)

-- OPEN FOLLOW-UPS / ONE-OFF ANALYSES --
* Capacity delta if fallback used for 24h (quick calc): assume 30% throughput shift -> projected extra tokens 1.2M -> cost band: medium
* Quick A/B of fallback latency: measure median p95 across staging, compare to prod; capture in PR analysis
* Evaluate whether dedicated-router sticky-session override increases RTO beyond SLA (assign to Theo)

-- NOTES TO SELF / INFORMAL --
- Keep this sheet lightweight; don't try to capture full runbooks here. This is a short-reference lattice for oncall and product owners.
- If you find repeated manual steps >3 times, escalate to runbook owner to automate.
- Slack shorthand: @oncall = escalation policy, use #ops-escalations for bridge notices.

-- QUICK AUDIT LOG (ad-hoc, fill when you do checks) --
2028-04-12: Jonah ran SMS test -> search primary ok, secondary failed (voicemail). Note: Priya to update pager contact.
2028-04-15: Priya push emergency rate-limit dry-run -> succeeded (no customer impact), PR merged.

-- END OF SHEET --

(Handy: paste this into a new spreadsheet if you prefer column sorting. Kept intentionally freeform for quick edits during incidents.)
